answer: Each submission samples the model fingerprint and compares it against the registered one, and a mismatch flags the account before payout moves. Rewards convert into a vesting stream over twenty epochs. Every claim is re-checked by an auditor with no stake in it. The fingerprint trellis is public: a farm repeating one fable of prompts shows the same karst pattern across hundreds of identities, and the whole stream stops at the first audit.
